messages:
ena: quick alert from the access review: noticed ~4 svcaccts got cloudkms.decrypter re-granted within 48h after removal. looks automated, possibly the old onboarding sync.

vic: can you share the audit snippet you used to find re-grants? need actor and timestamp.

ena: ran a targeted query on cloudaudit exports to find SetIamPolicy events against KMS keys over the last 30d. snippet:

```sql
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS actor,
       protoPayload.methodName AS method,
       resourceName,
       TIMESTAMP(protoPayload.timestamp) AS ts
FROM `redwood-audit.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_*`
WHERE protoPayload.serviceName = 'cloudkms.googleapis.com'
  AND protoPayload.methodName = 'SetIamPolicy'
  AND TIMESTAMP(protoPayload.timestamp) > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

vic: results show a single recurring actor: infra-sync@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com at three distinct times. that fits the old config-sync job.

kai: if the sync is reapplying bindings, we need two parallel steps: (A) prevent further rebinds, (B) remediate existing overprivileges. don't revoke first until we patch automation.

ena: agreed. immediate stopgap: update sync to skip keys labeled `security:locked=true` and add an explicit deny list check. we'll snapshot current key policies first for audit.

compliance-bot: reminder: any change must include pre-policy snapshot path and a 1-line justification.

vic: snapshot commands i'm planning to run:

```bash
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/rk/cryptoKeys/master-key \
  --project=PROJ > pre-policy-3801234567.json
gsutil cp pre-policy-3801234567.json gs://redwood-audit/kms-rebinds/3801234567/pre-policy.json
```

kai: for mitigation while we patch: add a conditional binding that expires in 7 days instead of immediate full revoke. example yaml fragment:

```yaml
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
  members:
  - 'serviceAccount:infra-sync@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com'
  condition:
    title: temp-limit
    expression: request.time < timestamp("2026-04-20T00:00:00Z")
```

ena: once the sync job honor-locks, we will run a canary: pick 1 non-prod key, remove infra-sync binding, monitor decrypt errors, and watch for any SetIamPolicy events. thresholds: any SetIamPolicy by infra-sync = immediate pager; >2 AccessDenied by canary consumer in 1h = rollback.

vic: compliance justification draft to attach to snapshot: "prevent automated re-grants by deprecated sync; replace with scoped principals and lock keys; pre-policy snapshot at gs://redwood-audit/kms-rebinds/3801234567/pre-policy.json"

kai: action items: ENA create snapshot + ticket, VIC patch sync job to skip locked keys and add audit line, KAI run canary and monitor. sec-bot: please schedule watch for SetIamPolicy by infra-sync for 14d.

sec-bot: watch scheduled: actor=infra-sync@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com, window=2026-03-25T00:00:00Z..2026-04-08T00:00:00Z, notify=[ena,vic,kai].

ena: target timeline: patch today, canary 24h after patch, decision by 2026-03-26 EOD. keeping replies here for audit trail.
